items.text: Puka Nacua listed QUESTIONABLE (calf); will test pregame per McVay. Prior limited practice Thursday, DNP Friday.
items.why: Calf felt lack of power/explosion; McVay confirmed pregame test.
items.implication: Game-time; if OUT massive TE funnel and WR2/3 upgrade.
items.opportunity: If OUT: Higbee primary, Parkinson, Atwell etc routes/targets spike.

items.text: Lamar Jackson QUESTIONABLE (ankle/high ankle sprain). Limited practice all week; said heading right direction but grace period to Sunday.
items.why: Returned limited; coach still working through availability.
items.implication: Crucial DFS/slate swing; if OUT Huntley start.

items.text: Breece Hall QUESTIONABLE (quad). Key DFS monitor.
items.implication: If active vs MIA start; if OUT handcuff upside.

items.text: Mike Evans and Deebo Samuel OUT. Confirmed by Shanahan/Schefter.
items.why: Evans Achilles/ribs; Deebo hamstring. Coach confirmed.
items.implication: 49ers WR corps decimated; heavy CMC/Kittle funnel.
items.opportunity: CMC slot/WR snaps; Kittle routes/targets/redzone massive.

items.text: OUT: Davante Adams, Rashee Rice, Jeremiyah Love, David Montgomery, Emeka Egbuka, Tyler Warren, Zach Charbonnet. IN: Josh Jacobs, Quinshon Judkins, Jordan Addison.
items.why: Official Friday designations; Schefter multi-OUT list matches.
items.implication: Adams long-term; Rice/Charbonnet create KC/SEA backfield clarity; Jacobs cleared facility activities.
items.opportunity: Charbonnet OUT: Walker/others; Montgomery OUT: Houston RB hierarchy; Warren OUT: Colts TE drop.

items.text: Saquon Barkley in line to return Week 7 vs DAL. If active, right back in lineups. Efficient in two full games; DAL good RB matchup.
items.why: Practice return; Stephania Bell agree start if active.
items.opportunity: Full role expected vs soft DAL run D.

items.text: If Puka Nacua can't go, Stafford hierarchy: 1. Tyler Higbee 2. Konata Mumpfield 3. Colby Parkinson 4. Tutu Atwell 5. Jordan Whittington 6. Davis Allen. Adams already long-term OUT.
items.why: McVay quotes on calf; no power/explosion; prior TE target share 37% when Puka out.
items.implication: Higbee clear TE1 streamer/DFS if Puka inactive.
items.opportunity: TE target share spike; Higbee #1 priority.

items.text: Colston Loveland BACK with Caleb: 30% target share, 19.2 PPR/g, 6+ rec and 60+ yards both games since return.
items.why: Post-Caleb return usage spike; Kmet IR further juice.

items.text: Really sweet setup for Bijan Robinson with Brian Robinson OUT. 49ers DvP inflates opposing RB by 4.4% (7th-most); recent RB receptions conceded high (White/Holani/Harvey/Love).
items.why: BRob OUT + SF pass-catching RB vulnerability data.
items.implication: Bijan elite RB1 ceiling this week.
items.opportunity: Full carries + receiving share; goal-line uncontested.

items.text: George Kittle will go nuts: scheme awesome + entire 49ers WR corps hurt (Evans/Deebo OUT). Ignore National TE Day narrative.
items.why: WR outs force funnel; Kittle elite talent/scheme.

items.text: Luther Burden only 68.8% routes but elite 2.56 YPRR. Kmet IR (season-ending knee) reduces 2/3-TE sets, giving Burden more juice.
items.why: Kmet confirmed IR by Schefter/Rapoport/Johnson; route rate room.
items.implication: Burden WR3/flex upside boost ROS short-term.

items.text: Rarely buy RB-as-WR hype, but 49ers dire WR situation + Kaelon Black presence tempts CMC more slot this week. CMC smiled at question.
items.why: WR injuries force creative usage; CMC comment.
items.conflict: Historical RB-WR alignment rarely materializes fully.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson played just 21% snaps last three weeks. Not like this.
items.implication: Fade until role expands; low floor.
